title: Technical indicators
description: Moving averages, Bollinger bands, VWAP, MACD, RSI, KDJ, ATR and Heikin-Ashi: declared in one line on a TradingChart, or computed with pure functions on plain arrays and Float64Array columns.

declarative.title: Declarative indicators
declarative.text: The indicators option lists the indicators in order: moving averages, Bollinger, Keltner and Donchian channels, VWAP, parabolic SAR, Ichimoku and SuperTrend are drawn over the price; volume (unless overlay), MACD, RSI, KDJ, ATR, OBV, CCI, stochastic RSI, DMI, Williams %R and MFI each get a pane below it. Every legend shows the values at the crosshair, and clicking an indicator name hides it.
declarative.ids: An indicator is identified by its type and parameters ("ma:7", "macd:12:26:9") unless it sets an id: indicatorToggle and setIndicatorVisible use it. Changing the list keeps the computed values of the indicators that did not change.

functions.title: Pure functions
functions.text: The same computations are exported by minerva-design/charts/core: they take plain arrays or typed arrays and return Float64Array columns, NaN until the window is full. Use them for signals, screeners, back-tests or a server, with the exact values the chart draws.

conventions.title: Conventions
conventions.averages: MA is the simple average, WMA weighs the newest bar the most, EMA uses 2 / (period + 1) and starts from the simple average of the first window, like TradingView.
conventions.wilder: RSI and ATR use Wilder's smoothing (1 / period); Bollinger bands use the population standard deviation.
conventions.kdj: KDJ starts K and D at 50 and smooths them over 3 bars by default; J = 3K − 2D can leave the 0-100 range.
conventions.vwap: VWAP restarts every day (or week, month, never) in the time zone of timeZone or utcOffset.
conventions.incremental: On every tick, the chart recomputes only the values of the last bar: a stream of updates costs the same with a hundred or a million bars.
conventions.zoom: Zoomed out, indicators keep being computed on every bar and are drawn with the lowest and highest value of each pixel column, so spikes stay visible on a million bars.
conventions.ichimoku: Ichimoku draws the leading spans displacement − 1 bars ahead (into the empty space after the last bar) and the lagging span as many bars back; the pure ichimoku function returns them unshifted.

props.name: id
props.description: Identifies the indicator in the legend, the events and the pane sizes; defaults to the type and its parameters (`"ma:7"`, `"macd:12:26:9"`)

props.name: visible
props.description: Draws the indicator; hidden indicators keep their legend entry, which shows them again

TradingPaneIndicatorBase.description: Options shared by the indicators drawn in their own pane

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the pane in pixels (the panes can be resized by dragging their separators)

TradingVolumeProfile.description: Volume by price of a range of bars, as computed by `volumeProfile`

props.name: low
props.description: Price at the bottom of the first row

props.name: high
props.description: Price at the top of the last row

props.name: step
props.description: Height of a row, in price

props.name: up
props.description: Volume of rising bars per row, bottom row first

props.name: down
props.description: Volume of falling bars per row

props.name: total
props.description: Total volume

props.name: poc
props.description: Row of the point of control (the largest volume); −1 without volume

props.name: valueAreaFrom
props.description: First row of the value area

props.name: valueAreaTo
props.description: Last row of the value area

props.name: setOptions
props.description: Replaces the options (bars, drawings, ... are replaced only when their reference changed)

props.name: setBars
props.description: Replaces the bars

props.name: update
props.description: Streams a bar: the same time as the last bar replaces it, a later time appends it. Cheap: call it on every tick.

props.name: appendBars
props.description: Appends bars newer than the last one

props.name: prependBars
props.description: Inserts older bars before the first one; the view stays on the same bars

props.name: getBarCount
props.description: Number of bars

props.name: getBar
props.description: Bar at an index, `null` outside the data

props.name: scrollToRealtime
props.description: Scrolls to the latest bar

props.name: fitContent
props.description: Shows every bar

props.name: getVisibleRange
props.description: Visible bars

props.name: setVisibleRange
props.description: Shows the bars between two logical indices

props.name: getVisibleTimeRange
props.description: Times at the edges of the plot (interpolated between bars)

props.name: setVisibleTimeRange
props.description: Shows the bars between two times

props.name: setCrosshair
props.description: Shows the crosshair at a time (and a price), as if the pointer were there; `null` hides it. Does not emit `crosshairMove`.

props.name: setScaleMode
props.description: Sets the price scale of the price pane

props.name: resetPriceScales
props.description: Fits every price scale to the visible bars again

props.name: setDrawingTool
props.description: Activates a drawing tool

props.name: getDrawingTool
props.description: Active drawing tool

props.name: getDrawings
props.description: Current drawings

props.name: setDrawings
props.description: Replaces the drawings

props.name: removeDrawing
props.description: Deletes a drawing

props.name: updateDrawing
props.description: Changes the style or the content of a drawing (undoable)

props.name: selectDrawing
props.description: Selects a drawing (`null` clears the selection)

props.name: undo
props.description: Undoes the last change of the drawings (also Ctrl / ⌘ + Z)

props.name: redo
props.description: Redoes the last undone change (also Ctrl / ⌘ + Shift + Z)

props.name: getUndoState
props.description: Whether the drawings can be undone or redone

props.name: startReplay
props.description: Starts a bar replay: the bars after `time` are hidden, then added back by `replayStep` or `replayPlay`. Without `time`, the user picks the first bar with a click.

props.name: replayStep
props.description: Shows the next bars of the replay

props.name: replayPlay
props.description: Adds `speed` bars per second (the current speed by default)

props.name: replayPause
props.description: Pauses the replay

props.name: stopReplay
props.description: Ends the replay and shows every bar

props.name: getReplayState
props.description: State of the bar replay

props.name: toDataURL
props.description: Image of the chart (bars, axes, drawings and legends) as a data URL

props.name: toBlob
props.description: Image of the chart as a blob (`null` without canvas support)

props.name: requestFullscreen
props.description: Shows the chart full screen

props.name: exitFullscreen
props.description: Leaves full screen

props.name: isFullscreen
props.description: Whether the chart is full screen

props.name: setIndicatorVisible
props.description: Shows or hides an indicator

props.name: getRenderer
props.description: Backend in use (`null` until ready or without canvas support)

props.name: ready
props.description: Resolves with the backend once the first frame can be drawn

props.name: refreshTheme
props.description: Reads the CSS variables again (theme changes are detected automatically)

props.name: resize
props.description: Draws again at the container size (resizes are detected automatically)

props.name: on
props.description: Subscribes to an event; returns the unsubscribe function

props.name: destroy
props.description: Removes the chart and frees the GPU resources

props.name: renderer
props.description: The backend in use (again when it changes after a GPU loss)

props.name: crosshairMove
props.description: The crosshair moved; `null` when it left the chart

props.name: click
props.description: A pane was clicked (not while drawing)

props.name: visibleRangeChange
props.description: The visible bars changed (scroll, zoom, resize, new bars)

props.name: orderMove
props.description: A draggable price line was dropped

props.name: orderCreate
props.description: The "+" order entry button was clicked

props.name: orderCancel
props.description: The close button of a price line was clicked

props.name: drawingsChange
props.description: Drawings were added, moved, restyled, deleted, undone or redone

props.name: drawingSelect
props.description: The selected drawing changed

props.name: drawingToolChange
props.description: The drawing tool changed (back to `cursor` after a drawing)

props.name: undoChange
props.description: Undo / redo became possible or impossible

props.name: indicatorToggle
props.description: An indicator was shown or hidden from the legend

props.name: historyRequest
props.description: The oldest bar came into view (see `prependBars`)

props.name: replayChange
props.description: The bar replay started, stepped, played, paused or stopped

props.name: fullscreenChange
props.description: The chart entered (`true`) or left full screen

examples.title: ATR
examples.description: The average true range measures volatility in price units. The pure atr() function places stop lines two ATR away from the last price.

examples.title: Bollinger bands
examples.description: A 20-bar average with bands a number of standard deviations away and a light fill between them; the bands widen when the volatility rises.

examples.title: Keltner and Donchian channels
examples.description: Keltner channels sit a number of average true ranges around an EMA, Donchian channels follow the highest high and lowest low, Bollinger bands use the standard deviation.

examples.title: RSI divergences
examples.description: rsi() and the swing highs and lows of the bars find regular divergences: a lower low with a higher RSI low (bullish), a higher high with a lower RSI high (bearish). Each one becomes two locked trendLine drawings, on the price pane and on the RSI pane (pane: "rsi:14").

examples.title: DMI and ADX
examples.description: +DI and −DI in the up and down colors, ADX in amber with its 25 line: above it, the trend is strong. The line below reads the last values from the pure dmi function.

examples.title: Heikin-Ashi
examples.description: Averaged bars that smooth out the noise: long runs of one color are trends. The pure heikinAshi() function counts the bars of the current run.

examples.title: Ichimoku cloud
examples.description: Conversion and base lines, the lagging span, and the cloud between the leading spans: in the up color while span A is above span B, in the down color otherwise. rightOffset leaves room for the cloud drawn 26 bars ahead.

examples.title: KDJ
examples.description: The stochastic K, D and J lines popular in Chinese markets, with MA5 / 20 and the red-up convention. J leaves the 0-100 range first.

examples.title: MACD
examples.description: The MACD line (12-bar EMA minus 26-bar EMA), its 9-bar signal and the histogram of their difference: bright when it grows, faded when it shrinks. Both EMAs are drawn over the price.

examples.title: MA, EMA and WMA
examples.description: The three averages over the same period: the exponential and weighted ones follow the price faster than the simple one. Change the period to see the lag grow.

examples.title: Multiple timeframes
examples.description: resampleBars aggregates the hourly bars into 4-hour and daily bars, and ema() computes their 20-bar average; each hourly bar only sees the last closed higher bar (no look-ahead), drawn with compare over the hourly EMA. onCrosshairMove tells whether the close sits above all three averages.

examples.title: On-balance volume
examples.description: OBV adds the volume of up closes and subtracts the volume of down closes; its 20-bar average shows whether buying or selling pressure dominates. Large values use compact units of the page language.

examples.title: Oscillators
examples.description: Stochastic RSI and MFI between 0 and 100 (20 / 80 bands), CCI around ±100 and Williams %R between −100 and 0. Each one gets its pane; the chart grows with them.

examples.title: RSI
examples.description: A 14-bar and a fast 6-bar RSI, each in its pane with its overbought / oversold band. Switch between the 70 / 30 and 80 / 20 bands.

examples.title: Indicator screener
examples.description: rsi(), macd(), atr() and sma() run on six symbols to fill a sortable Table: RSI, MACD histogram, ATR as a share of the price, distance from the 50-day average and a signal. Pick a symbol to open its chart with the same indicators.

examples.title: Signals from the pure functions
examples.description: ema() and rsi() on the closes: a buy when the 9-bar EMA crosses above the 21-bar EMA with an RSI over 50, a sell on the cross back. The trades become markers, and their results are summed up below.

examples.title: SuperTrend and parabolic SAR
examples.description: Trailing stops that flip with the trend: the SuperTrend band, colored up or down, and the SAR dots. The buy / sell markers are the flips computed with the pure supertrend function.

examples.title: Without React
examples.description: createTradingChart from minerva-design/charts/core mounts the same chart in any element: options, on() events and destroy(). Here sma() tells how far the hovered close is from its 50-day average.

examples.title: VWAP
examples.description: Five trading sessions of five-minute bars: the volume-weighted average price restarts at every session, with the volume pane below. utcOffset={0} shows the exchange times as written.

snippets.source:
<TradingChart
  bars={bars}
  indicators={[
    { type: "ma", period: 7 },          // over the price
    { type: "boll", period: 20, multiplier: 2 },
    { type: "volume", maPeriod: 20 },   // panes below, in this order
    { type: "macd", fast: 12, slow: 26, signal: 9 },
    { type: "rsi", period: 14, overbought: 70, oversold: 30 },
  ]}
/>

data.vwapAria: Five-minute chart over five sessions with the VWAP and the volume
data.macdAria: Daily chart with the MACD pane
data.rsiAria: Four-hour chart with a 14-bar and a 6-bar RSI
data.kdjAria: Daily chart with the KDJ pane
data.atrAria: Hourly chart of gold with the ATR and volatility stops
data.signalsAria: Hourly chart with EMA cross signals and RSI
data.vanillaWarmup: Not enough bars yet for the 50-day average
data.vanillaAbove: The close is {{value}} above its 50-day average
data.vanillaBelow: The close is {{value}} below its 50-day average
data.ichimokuAria: Nikkei 225 daily chart with the Ichimoku cloud
data.supertrendAria: SOL/USDT four-hour chart with the SuperTrend and its flips
data.channelsAria: EUR/USD hourly chart with a price channel
data.oscillatorsAria: BTC/USDT four-hour chart with oscillator panes

dmiSummary.weak: ADX {{adx}}: no strong trend, {{direction}} for now

data.dmiAria: MSFT daily chart with the DMI pane
data.obvAria: AAPL daily chart with the volume and the OBV
data.divergenceAria: SOL/USDT four-hour chart with RSI divergences drawn
data.mtfAria: ETH/USDT hourly chart with the 20-bar EMA of the hourly, 4-hour and daily bars
data.screenChartAria: {{name}} daily chart with the 50-day average, RSI and MACD

TradingMovingAverageIndicator.type: ma simple, ema exponential, wma weighted
TradingMovingAverageIndicator.source: Price averaged: open, high, low, close, hl2, hlc3 or ohlc4
TradingMovingAverageIndicator.color: Line color; a palette color by default

TradingBollingerIndicator.period: Bars of the average and of the deviation
TradingBollingerIndicator.multiplier: Distance of the bands in standard deviations
TradingBollingerIndicator.colors: Colors of the middle, upper and lower lines
TradingBollingerIndicator.fill: Fills the space between the bands

TradingVwapIndicator.reset: Period after which the average restarts: day, week, month or none

TradingVolumeIndicator.type: Volume bars colored like their bars
TradingVolumeIndicator.maPeriod: Period of a moving average drawn over the volume
TradingVolumeIndicator.overlay: Draws the volume at the bottom of the price pane instead of its own pane

TradingMacdIndicator.type: MACD line, signal line and histogram
TradingMacdIndicator.colors: Colors of the MACD and signal lines

TradingKdjIndicator.period: Bars of the highest high / lowest low window
TradingKdjIndicator.colors: Colors of the K, D and J lines

TradingIndicatorBase.id: Identifies the indicator in the legend, the events and the pane sizes; the type and parameters by default
TradingIndicatorBase.visible: Draws the indicator; a hidden one keeps its legend entry to show it again

TradingPaneIndicatorBase.height: Height of the pane in pixels (separators can be dragged)

TradingChartInstance.setOptions: Replaces the options; bars and drawings are applied only when their reference changed
TradingChartInstance.update: Streams a bar: the time of the last bar replaces it, a later time appends it
TradingChartInstance.appendBars: Appends bars newer than the last one
TradingChartInstance.prependBars: Inserts older bars before the first one, keeping the view
TradingChartInstance.getBar: Bar at an index, null outside the data
TradingChartInstance.setVisibleRange: Shows the bars between two logical indices
TradingChartInstance.setScaleMode: Sets the price scale: linear, log or percent
TradingChartInstance.resetPriceScales: Fits every price scale to the visible bars again
TradingChartInstance.selectDrawing: Selects a drawing (null clears the selection)
TradingChartInstance.getRenderer: Backend in use, null until ready
TradingChartInstance.ready: Resolves with the backend once the first frame can be drawn
TradingChartInstance.refreshTheme: Reads the CSS variables again (theme changes are detected automatically)
TradingChartInstance.resize: Draws again at the container size (resizes are detected automatically)
TradingChartInstance.on: Subscribes to an event; returns the unsubscribe function
TradingChartInstance.destroy: Removes the chart and frees the GPU resources
TradingChartInstance.getVisibleTimeRange: Times at the edges of the plot (interpolated between bars).
TradingChartInstance.setVisibleTimeRange: Shows the bars between two times.
TradingChartInstance.setCrosshair: Shows the crosshair at a time (and a price), as if the pointer were there; null hides it. Does not emit crosshairMove.
TradingChartInstance.updateDrawing: Changes the style or the content of a drawing (undoable).
TradingChartInstance.undo: Undoes the last change of the drawings (also Ctrl / ⌘ + Z).
TradingChartInstance.redo: Redoes the last undone change (also Ctrl / ⌘ + Shift + Z).
TradingChartInstance.getUndoState: Whether the drawings can be undone or redone.
TradingChartInstance.startReplay: Starts a bar replay: the bars after time are hidden, then added back by replayStep or replayPlay. Without time, the user picks the first bar with a click.
TradingChartInstance.replayStep: Shows the next bars of the replay.
TradingChartInstance.replayPlay: Adds speed bars per second (the current speed by default).
TradingChartInstance.stopReplay: Ends the replay and shows every bar.
TradingChartInstance.toDataURL: Image of the chart (bars, axes, drawings and legends) as a data URL.
TradingChartInstance.toBlob: Image of the chart as a blob (null without canvas support).
TradingChartInstance.isFullscreen: Whether the chart is full screen.

TradingChartEventMap.renderer: The backend in use, again after a fallback
TradingChartEventMap.crosshairMove: The crosshair moved; null when it left the chart
TradingChartEventMap.orderMove: A draggable price line was dropped
TradingChartEventMap.drawingsChange: Drawings were added, moved, restyled, deleted, undone or redone.
TradingChartEventMap.indicatorToggle: An indicator was shown or hidden from its legend
TradingChartEventMap.historyRequest: The oldest bar came into view
TradingChartEventMap.orderCreate: The + order entry button was clicked.
TradingChartEventMap.orderCancel: The close button of a price line was clicked.
TradingChartEventMap.undoChange: Undo / redo became possible or impossible.
TradingChartEventMap.replayChange: The bar replay started, stepped, played, paused or stopped.
TradingChartEventMap.fullscreenChange: The chart entered (true) or left full screen.

TradingParabolicSarIndicator.increment: Increase of the factor at each new extreme.
TradingParabolicSarIndicator.color: Color of the dots; the up / down colors by trend by default.

TradingIchimokuIndicator.spanBPeriod: Bars of the leading span B (Senkou span B).
TradingIchimokuIndicator.displacement: Shift of the leading spans (ahead) and of the lagging span (back), in bars.
TradingIchimokuIndicator.colors: Colors of the conversion, base, lagging, leading A and leading B lines.
TradingIchimokuIndicator.cloud: Fills the cloud between the leading spans: the up color while span A is above span B, the down color otherwise.

TradingSupertrendIndicator.period: Bars of the average true range.
TradingSupertrendIndicator.multiplier: Distance of the band, in average true ranges.
TradingSupertrendIndicator.upColor: Color of the band in an uptrend; the up color by default.
TradingSupertrendIndicator.downColor: Color of the band in a downtrend; the down color by default.

TradingKeltnerIndicator.multiplier: Distance of the bands, in average true ranges.
TradingKeltnerIndicator.atrPeriod: Bars of the average true range.
TradingKeltnerIndicator.colors: Colors of the middle, upper and lower lines.

TradingDonchianIndicator.colors: Colors of the middle, upper and lower lines.

TradingObvIndicator.maPeriod: Period of a moving average drawn over the line.

TradingStochRsiIndicator.stochPeriod: Bars of the stochastic of the RSI.
TradingStochRsiIndicator.colors: Colors of the K and D lines.

TradingDmiIndicator.colors: Colors of the +DI, −DI and ADX lines.

TradingVolumeProfile.low: Price at the bottom of the first row.
TradingVolumeProfile.high: Price at the top of the last row.
TradingVolumeProfile.step: Height of a row, in price.
TradingVolumeProfile.up: Volume of rising bars per row, bottom row first.
TradingVolumeProfile.down: Volume of falling bars per row.
TradingVolumeProfile.poc: Row of the point of control (the largest volume); −1 without volume.
TradingVolumeProfile.valueAreaFrom: First row of the value area.
TradingVolumeProfile.valueAreaTo: Last row of the value area.

bollinger.title: Bollinger bands from the pure functions
bollinger.description: bollinger() and ema() of minerva-design/charts/core compute the series, drawn by a range area chart.

panes.title: Indicator panes
panes.description: The trading chart computes Bollinger bands, MACD and RSI itself; macd() gives the last values outside of it.
